audit.whatIsWrong: This is a symmetric artillery-mage skillshot duel, correctly rated even/Skill across the whole chart in both layers.
audit.why: Both champions are max-range pokers with no sustain and cooldown-limited engage; the packet's win rate (50.75%) and level chart confirm a true mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named an ability 'Tectonic Disruption' (Malphite's ult, not Xerath's) and carried no digit, tripping the cooldown-digit lint check.
audit.why: Xerath's real numbers are Shocking Orb (E) 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s at 1050 range, and Rite of the Arcane (R) 130/115/100s, which immobilizes him while channeling.
audit.corrected: Shocking Orb (E) is 13-11s at 1050 range — his only CC, and it's a skillshot you can sidestep. Rite of the Arcane (R) is 130/115/100s and immobilizes him while channeling — punish the window, don't feed it.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles ('Dodge the keystone first' and 'Clump with the carry').
audit.why: Xerath's Q (750 range) is shorter than Vel'Koz's Q (1050 range), and his W (Eye of Destruction) is an AoE barrage that punishes clumping — both matchup-specific facts the generic bleed text never states.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d -> the range-edge poke fact; dontsFull[2].d -> the W-clump punish.
